response: THE PATH OF A MILK DELIVERY ROUND FOR A COMMUNITY BULLETIN IS AS FOLLOWS: THE DELIVERY TEAM STARTS AT THE COMMUNITY CENTER, THEN VISITS EACH HOUSE IN SEQUENCE, DELIVERING MILK TO EACH FAMILY. THEY MAKE AROUND 10 HOUSES, THEN RETURN TO THE CENTER. THE ENTIRE ROUND TAKES ABOUT 2 HOURS. ALL DELIVERIES ARE MADE IN THE MORNING TO PREVENT LATE DELIVERIES. THE TEAM WORKS TO MAKE SURE EVERY HOUSE RECEIVES MILK. THIS ROUTINE HELPS SUPPORT LOCAL FAMILIES AND PROMOTES HEALTH.
